original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥法银行抢劫案：萨拉基指责夸拉州政府撤销指控
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚前参议院议长布科拉·萨拉基指控夸拉州政府在2018年奥法银行抢劫案相关诉讼中滥用司法程序。据其媒体办公室声明，州政府已撤销针对他和前州长阿卜杜勒法塔赫·艾哈迈德的20项指控中的18项，包括武装抢劫、导致警员死亡及非法持有枪支等指控。萨拉基称此举表明相关指控不实，并认为修改后的剩余指控同样难以成立。上述说法来自萨拉基一方，目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 萨拉基指控夸拉州政府在撤销指控一事上滥用司法程序
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Former Senate President Bukola Saraki has accused the Kwara State Government of abusing the judicial process after it dropped 18 armed robbery-related charges against him and former Governor Abdulfatah Ahmed

key_facts.fact: 州政府撤销了20项指控中的18项，涉及武装抢劫、致警员死亡和非法持有枪支
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the state government had dropped 18 of the 20 counts in the original charge sheet, including allegations of armed robbery, causing the deaths of police officers and illegal possession of firearms

key_facts.fact: 案件与2018年奥法银行抢劫案相关
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Offa bank robbery: Saraki slams Kwara over dropped charges

key_facts.fact: 剩余两项指控涉及共谋加入盗窃团伙及隐瞒涉案车辆
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the government retained two charges, which alleged that Saraki and Ahmed conspired to belong to a gang of thieves and actually belonged to such a gang, as well as allegations relating to concealing or causing the disappearance of a vehicle allegedly used for illegal purposes

uncertainties: 萨拉基关于指控不实的说法为其单方主张，尚未获独立证实
报道目前仅有一个来源（Punch），缺乏交叉验证
剩余两项指控的审理结果尚不明确
